title: I've had this Pokémon game idea since the 90s. Six months of nights and weekends with AI, and it's real.
author: mpb024
selftext:
I've been playing Pokémon since the 90s and I always had an idea for my own game: play as the villain, steal abilities and put them on any Pokémon. I just never had the time.

Over the last six months I spent my nights and weekends building it with AI, and my dream became a real game. It's called FANTASMA, a Pokémon Emerald hack where you're a ghost haunting a darker Hoenn. You steal abilities, wear gym leaders' faces and rob the place while the League hunts you.

How it works: I came up with the ideas and make all the design decisions. AI agents wrote the code and painted the backgrounds, and they test each build in an emulator before I play it. I playtest everything myself and build the new maps by hand. I had to iterate a million times 😵‍💫

AI let me build 22+ new features, most of which I've never seen in a game before. A small example: I like to play sped up at 2-3x, so I built speed controls right into the game.

Part I is the full Hoenn story and it's free.

Check it out: [hackdex.app/hack/fantasma](http://www.hackdex.app/hack/fantasma)

comments.author: Honest_Welcome3932
comments.body: If you've really spent 6 months and the game is a personal passion of yours, I heavily recommend rewriting the dialogue yourself. Doesn't really matter if you're more or less confident on it, LLM dialogue and pretty much any of its writing is atrocious and stands out super fast, whereas your own wouldn't.

replies.author: mpb024
replies.body: You know what, you're 100% right. I'm reviewing every edited line now. It wasn't an efficient process (\~2,700 commits since May 27th) but yea, 6 months. If any lines jump out at you, tell me which ones.

replies.author: mpb024
replies.body: Many Emerald hacks are based on the “pokeemerald-expansion” which is a modified version of the gba file.  To be honest, I don’t know how to make a net new gba game.  But I bet some smart people here do know how.

comments.author: iSpokeToMasterChief
comments.body:
This is very interesting, is there a plot synopsis available? Does the ghost go around robbing every place from the museum at slateport to space center at mossdeep? are there any interactions with team aqua or magma? or anyone specific to emerald like steven or wallace? what about brendan and may, can you battle the protagonists of the original game/do they still live in littleroot? does the League operate like any other villain team in pokemon except this time they're the good guys hunting you down? could you battle their leader? any legendary encounters? im very curious about the progression of the story and exploring your hoenn! i'm definitely playing this ASAP

I think it would be sick if you introduced bounty hunters so even regular trainers like the hikers could potentially be chasing after you

replies.author: mpb024
replies.body: Great questions, I think overall you’ll be pleased.  Without spoiling it about 70% of the questions you asked are yes, in the game in a big way, and 30% no… axed.  25+ legendary fights

replies.author: mpb024
replies.body: And yes bounty hunter attacks are based on the wanted level, which is dependent on how much chaos you cause.
